How to read thisLists PVCs and StorageClasses from the Kubernetes API.GET /api/v1/storage/usage enriches rows when VEYRON_PROMETHEUS_URL points at Prometheus /api/v1/query (kubelet kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes) and adds per-class CSI capacity hints from CSIStorageCapacity. Optimization Recommendations

    

      

        

          
Downsize idle VMs
VMs with sustained low CPU may be over-provisioned

          
        

        

          
Delete orphaned PVCs
Unbound PersistentVolumeClaims accumulate storage costs

          
        

        

          
Schedule-based shutdown
Stop dev/test VMs outside business hours

          
        

        

          
Move to cheaper storage class
Cold workloads can use HDD or object storage tiers
